integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Claymation. A tiny praying mantis stands on a mushroom in a mossy forest clearing, holding a dewdrop like a lantern. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. A huge shoebill stork lands on a branch above it and peers down. The giant with a deep, slow, booming voice (S1) says: <d>[English] What are you carrying, little one?</d> [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the shot fades to the praying mantis lifting the dewdrop high, a miniature sunrise glowing orange and gold inside it. The camera holds a static shot. The little one with a tiny, squeaky, excited voice (S2) says: <d>[English] Tomorrow!</d>

overall_soundscape: Leaves rustle as the bird lands. A soft crystalline chime rings out.

non_diegetic_music: A music box melody over pizzicato strings at a slow tempo, quiet throughout.
